description: This file defines the DefaultTbActorSystem class, which manages actor dispatchers, actors, message passing, and lifecycle operations within the Thingsboard server's actor system.

classes.name: DefaultTbActorSystem
classes.description: Main class implementing actor system management, including actor creation, messaging, broadcasting, and shutdown.

methods.name: createDispatcher
methods.description: Registers a new dispatcher with a specific ID and executor.

methods.name: destroyDispatcher
methods.description: Removes and shuts down a dispatcher by ID.

methods.name: getActor
methods.description: Retrieves an actor reference by actor ID.

methods.name: createRootActor
methods.description: Creates a root actor with a specified dispatcher and creator.

methods.name: createChildActor
methods.description: Creates a child actor under a specified parent.

methods.name: tellWithHighPriority
methods.description: Sends a message to an actor with high priority.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Sends a message to an actor.

methods.name: broadcastToChildren
methods.description: Broadcasts a message to all children of a parent actor.

methods.name: filterChildren
methods.description: Filters children of a parent actor based on a predicate.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops an actor by reference or ID, including its children.
